questions.answer: Det krævede en indsats, men der mange muligheder.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er let at leve i Milano og det er god mulig for offentlig transport til og fra fakulteterne.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var let at blive registreret. Det var også let at vælge kurser, men kursuskataloget var svært at finde rundt i.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var en mail med de relevante oplysninger.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de fag, som jeg havde søgt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hav et bredt udvalg af fag, som du er interesseret i at have, så man kan tilpasse sit skema efter hvilke fag, der faktisk bliver udbudt og hvornår de ligger på ugen.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det akademiske niveau var generelt lavere end på UCPH. Dette var især tilfældet for BA kurser.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der var færre opgaver og derfor mindre opfølgning på pensum. Modsat havde vi flere præsentationer, som jeg synes var en spændende tilføjelse.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Game Theory
Time Series and Forecasting
Business History
Coding
Global and climate change economics.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Global and Climate Change Economics. Professoren var meget engageret, hvilket gjorde undervisningen spændende. Faget giver både en dyb indsigt i det naturvidenskabelige grundlag bag klimaforandringer og global opvarmning, men også hvordan man kan tilgå problemet gennem makroøkonomi og økonometri. Faget giver en god forståelse for hvordan man kan arbejde økonomisk med klima og hvilke fordele og ulemper, der er forbundet med forskellige politiske løsninger. Stor anbefaling til alle, der gerne vil have en bedre forståelse for klimaøkonomi.

Additional comments:

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ingen.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Der er mulighed for at deltage i nogle sociale aktiviteter som helt sikkert kunne være interessant.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Brug de gode togforbindelser til at komme op i bjergene og rundt til de nærliggende byer. I sommerperioden er både kysten, søerne og bjergene utroligt skønne.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Italienere jeg mødte var meget imødekommende.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Deltag i de sociale aktiviteter.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der er meget burekrati og det er generelt et ineffektivt samfund, så nogle praktiske processer kan tage lang tid.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Man skal bruge byens tilbud i hverdagen. Mad og kaffe bør indtages på restauranter og caféer, hvis man ønsker at få den fulde italienske oplevelse.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Brug byen til at spise, drikke og mødes. Rejs rundt i Norditalien med tog, der er virkelig mange gode destinationer indenfor et par timers rejsetid. Undgå at cykle, da byen ikke er designet til det. Brug i stedet den offentlige transport eller gå rundt i byen.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De kulturelle oplevelser.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Burekratien og besværlige processer.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
